People: Eric Mackay (author, Wikidata Q5387019), died 1898; James Fagan (illustrator, Wikidata Q130643929), died 1910. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Mackay, Eric, 1851-1898; Fagan, James, 1864-1910 [Illustrator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Love letters of a violinist, and other poems, New York, Chicago [etc.] Brentano's, 1894, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/lovelettersavio00fagagoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 92%, 100%, 83% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of James Fagan, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
